coking_coal.handling_constraint: Moderate risk of spontaneous combustion if stacked wet.

iron_ore.handling_constraint: CRITICAL: High moisture causes liquefaction (cargo turns into fluid mud). Halt discharge in heavy rain.

fertilizer.handling_constraint: CRITICAL: Water-soluble chemical cargo. Any rain during discharge leads to total cargo dissolution.

pol_liquid.handling_constraint: Pipeline manifold discharge. High surface winds (>25 knots) force marine hose disconnection.
